description: #86 A2: a branch filter holding a `!` pattern is uncertain, never every-PR: GitHub applies a later negation after a positive match.

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ["**", "!main"]
jobs:
  test:
    name: Test suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - run: python3 -m unittest
